players.product: Specialty (meth)acrylate monomers used as raw materials for ArF and EUV photoresists (Electronic Materials segment, semiconductor materials group)

quarterly_data.signal: Segment outlook for the fiscal year ending November 2026 (results presentation): net sales Electronic Materials JPY 20.30 billion, Chemical Products JPY 14.50 billion, Specialty Chemicals JPY 7.70 billion. Electronic Materials quarterly chart: Q3 net sales JPY 5.88 billion (Q3 of the prior year JPY 4.44 billion) and operating profit JPY 1.41 billion at a 24.0% margin; Q4 net sales forecast JPY 4.73 billion.
quarterly_data.figure: FY11/26 Electronic Materials sales outlook JPY 20.30 billion; Q3 Electronic Materials sales JPY 5.88 billion, margin 24.0%
quarterly_data.quarter: Osaka Organic Chemical Industry TDnet: Presentation Materials for Financial Results for the Third (10-09-2026)

quarterly_data.signal: Company view of the Electronic Materials operating environment (results presentation): the semiconductor market continued to grow at a high rate, driven mainly by demand for AI applications; the memory market continued to face a tight supply-and-demand situation on demand for AI data centers, with contract prices for both DRAM and NAND on an upward trend; in display, a major Taiwanese manufacturer shifted its focus to high-value-added panels and Japanese manufacturers are withdrawing from large-sized LCD panels. Market risks it lists: continuation and escalation of the U.S.-China economic confrontation, slowing demand for end products due to soaring memory prices, and progress in in-house production of semiconductors in China.
quarterly_data.quarter: Osaka Organic Chemical Industry TDnet: Presentation Materials for Financial Results for the Third (10-09-2026)

quarterly_data.signal: Operating profit bridge, nine months to August 2026 (results presentation): operating profit up JPY 2.94 billion; net sales up JPY 5.59 billion (Electronic materials +JPY 3.31 billion, Chemical products +JPY 1.14 billion, Specialty chemicals +JPY 1.14 billion); raw material costs up JPY 2.25 billion, with the company-estimated price of naphtha in Japan at JPY 94,200/KL (JPY 67,566/KL a year earlier), offset mainly by lower depreciation and a positive inventory-valuation impact. Depreciation and amortization has been decreasing since its 2024 peak: JPY 2.02 billion for the nine months, projected JPY 2.79 billion for the full year. Company view of other segments: global automobile production was in a shrinking phase in 2026 due to U.S. tariff policies, geopolitical risks and slowing demand, and display panel makers kept lowering utilization; demand for specialty-chemical related materials increased on the strong semiconductor market.
quarterly_data.figure: Operating profit +JPY 2.94 billion; raw material costs +JPY 2.25 billion; full-year depreciation JPY 2.79 billion projected
